title: msi-builder configuration, schema msi-builder/v1
description: Editor support for msi-builder YAML files. docs/design/yaml-schema.md is the reference, and msi-builder validate checks every rule, including the ones a JSON Schema cannot express.

vars.description: Defaults for ${NAME} substitution. A value may use other variables; --var and --env values override it.

anyOf.description: x86, x64 or arm64 (aliases intel, amd64, aarch64), any case.

installerVersion.description: major.minor, or a major alone such as 5 for 5.0; Page Count is major × 100 + minor.

anyOf.description: Major upgrade policy. Absent or true: the standard policy. false: no Upgrade rows.

minVersion.description: Oldest version the major upgrade removes; older versions stay installed side by side.

includeMin.description: Whether minVersion itself is removed; only with minVersion.

upgrade.description: Major upgrade policy. Absent or true: the standard policy. false: no Upgrade rows.

installDir.description: The product's main folder and the default directory of every component. A string is the folder name.

id.description: Directory id and property. Default INSTALLDIR.

name.description: Folder name; / separates nested folders. Default: product.name (Programs/<name> for perUser).

parent.description: Standard folder. Default: ProgramFiles64Folder, ProgramFilesFolder on x86, LocalAppDataFolder for perUser.

remember.description: Store the chosen folder in the registry and use it again on the next install, so that a major upgrade keeps a custom folder. A folder given on the command line still wins.

search.description: Fills the property from the target machine before the install. A command-line value wins; value is the fallback when nothing is found. A list is tried in order; the first search that finds something wins.

error.description: Text or an Error table number.

command.description: The command line. Quote the executable when it comes from a property or folder reference: "[#tool.exe]" --init.

run.description: Runs a command through the custom action DLL msi-builder embeds: hidden window, output in the log, exit code checked.

command.description: The command line. Quote the executable when it comes from a property or folder reference: "[#tool.exe]" --init.

exe.description: Type 2: the engine writes the binary to a temporary file, runs it and deletes it.

binary.description: A binaries key holding a Windows program.

scope.description: In a perUserOrMachine or perMachineOrUser package only: run the action only in this context (the execute sequence only). A perMachine action may run without impersonation.

return.description: Required for exec, execProperty, exe and run.

progress.description: Description in the ActionText table: the wizard's progress page shows a deferred action's text while it runs, and the verbose log writes it (under /qn only for deferred actions). Formatted: [Property] references are resolved.

at.description: An absolute sequence number, or -1 to -4 in UI sequences.

when.description: ANDed with condition. install: first install, not a major upgrade. upgrade: the new version of a major upgrade. uninstall: a real removal, not the old product's removal during a major upgrade. maintenance: repair, change, patch or minor upgrade of an installed product. Allowed in execute; install and upgrade also in ui.

scheduleReboot.description: Ask for a restart at the end of the installation: ScheduleReboot after InstallFinalize. With /norestart or REBOOT=ReallySuppress msiexec returns 3010 instead of restarting; a quiet install without them may restart without asking.

when.description: The case it runs in, ANDed with condition.

enabled.description: Shows the setup wizard: welcome, ready, progress and finish pages plus maintenance, cancel and error dialogs. Without it msiexec shows only its basic progress window.

chooseFeatures.description: Adds the feature tree page after the welcome and license pages, with Browse for a feature's directory.

license.description: A license file shown with an accept check box after the welcome page: RTF, or UTF-8 text converted to RTF.

languages.description: Further wizard languages by LCID (1031) or language tag (de, de-AT), each built as an embedded language transform that msiexec picks by the user's regional format. A field left out keeps the base language's value; texts missing from strings take the built-in translation.

progress.description: Replaces the progress texts of customActions in this language, by action ID.

text.description: Replaces ui.launch.text in this language; & marks the access key.

dialogs.description: Texts of ui.dialogs pages in this language, by dialog id. A text left out keeps the base language's.

fields.description: Texts of the page's fields, by the property the field binds.

options.description: Labels of a choice field's options, by option value; & marks the access key.

chooseDirectory.description: Adds a page after the welcome and license pages that shows the install folder (installDir) and lets the user change it.

finishText.description: Formatted paragraph shown on the finish page below its standard text; hidden by the condition Installed OR ACTION = "ADMIN".

launch.description: A check box on the finish page that starts an installed program when the user clicks Finish.

file.description: The id of an installed file, or its name when it has no id.

text.description: The check box label; & marks the access key. Default: &Launch [ProductName].

checked.description: Whether the box starts checked. Default: true.

banner.description: BMP, PNG or JPEG for the top of the inner pages, 370x44 dialog units (493x58 pixels at 96 dpi).

dialog.description: BMP, PNG or JPEG background of the welcome and finish pages, 370x234 dialog units (493x312 pixels at 96 dpi).

colors.description: Colours of the built-in pictures as #RRGGBB.

after.description: The wizard dialog this one follows in its flow. Install flow: WelcomeDlg, LicenseAgreementDlg, InstallScopeDlg, InstallDirDlg, CustomizeDlg or an added dialog. Remove flow: MaintenanceTypeDlg (the default) or an added remove dialog.

flow.description: install: a page of a new installation, between the welcome and the ready page. remove: a page between Remove in the maintenance menu and the page that confirms the removal, such as a check box that a purge condition reads.

type.description: text: a label and an edit field. password: the same with the characters hidden; the property is added to MsiHiddenProperties. checkbox: a check box with the label as its text. choice: a label and one radio button per option.

options.description: choice only: the values the property can take, in display order. A string is a value shown as is.

label.description: The radio button text; & marks the access key. Default: the value.

value.description: checkbox only: the value a checked box sets the property to. Default: 1.

type.description: Column type in .idt notation: s72, I2, L0, V0, ...

id.description: Directory key and the property that holds its path.

name.description: Directory name (the long name; the 8.3 short name is generated). Required below the top level.

configurable.description: Public and Secure, so it can be set on the command line and in the UI.

default.description: Whether the feature is installed by default: on is level 1, off is level 2, disabled is level 0. Use it or level, not both.

level.description: 0 disables the feature. Use it or default, not both.

conditions.description: Levels that replace the feature's level when their condition is true (Condition table). The builder adds NOT Installed, so they apply to first installs; a condition that enables a disabled feature also holds at removals and repairs, so the uninstall removes the feature. At an upgrade a feature keeps the old version's state unless a condition or its own disabled level leaves it out, or the old version had disabled it. Windows applies them also when ADDLOCAL is set.

components.description: Component ids, or components defined in place.

firewall.description: Rules that follow the feature's state, without component.

condition.description: Evaluated in CostFinalize; it cannot ask for feature or component states.

default.description: The level to set: on is 1, off is 2, disabled is 0. Use it or level, not both.

level.description: The level to set. Use it or default, not both.

anyOf.description: A GUID, with or without braces, in any case.

upgradeCode.description: A GUID that never changes for a product. The nil GUID is rejected.

var.description: A value with a ${NAME} variable. It is checked after substitution, by msi-builder validate.

permissions.description: Permissions of the object: sddl writes an MsiLockPermissionsEx row that replaces its ACL (SEC-01); grant adds ACEs and keeps the ones there (SEC-02).

sddl.description: SDDL text. <DOMAIN\\account> forms are resolved at install time; [Property] references are not.

grant.description: Access-allowed ACEs added to the DACL of a file, folder or service after it is installed; inherited and other explicit ACEs stay. Not for registry values.

account.description: Formatted at install time: a [Property], a SID string, an SDDL alias such as NS, LocalSystem, NT AUTHORITY\\LocalService, NT AUTHORITY\\NetworkService, .\\name for a local account, or another account name.

rights.description: Files and folders: full, modify, readExecute, read, write. Services: full, read, start, stop, pauseContinue. Or a hexadecimal mask (0x...) without generic bits.

inherit.description: Folders only: the ACE also applies to subfolders and files (OICI). Default true.

id.description: Default: generated from the key file's name, else the service name, else the directory.

directory.description: A directory id, a standard folder, or a folder path such as bin or CommonAppDataFolder/MyApp. Default: the install dir.

source.description: Path relative to the YAML file, or absolute. A source that ends in / (or \) is a folder: the component becomes one component per file below it, with subfolders as directories below the component's directory (see the YAML schema doc).

name.description: Defaults to the base name of source. The long name; the 8.3 short name is generated.

id.description: File key. Default: the name, with characters an identifier cannot hold replaced by _ (fleetspeak-client.exe becomes fleetspeak_client.exe); see the YAML schema doc for leading digits and long names.

version.description: auto, a four-field version, the id of another file (companion), or its name when it has no id, or none. Never empty.

language.description: auto, none or a language list.

fileTypes.description: File types this file opens: Registry rows under HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT for the ProgID, its verbs and the extensions that point at it.

description.description: The type's name in Explorer, written as it is: [PROPERTY] references are not formatted.

iconIndex.description: Icon resource of the file for DefaultIcon; leave out for none.

contentType.description: MIME type written as Content Type.

openWithOnly.description: Only list the ProgID in the extension's Open with menu (OpenWithProgids); keep its default program and content type.

verbs.description: Shell verbs; default one open verb, [] for none.

id.description: Verb key, such as open or edit.

text.description: Menu text; empty shows the shell's text for the id.

arguments.description: Arguments after the quoted file path, as formatted text; default "%1", empty for none.

close.description: Close running copies of this program (an .exe) when its component is installed, repaired or removed: WM_CLOSE to its windows on the installing user's desktop before InstallValidate, then, unless terminate is false, the processes still running from the installed path are ended after StopServices. Copies in other folders are left alone.

timeout.description: A Go duration such as 10s: how long the program gets to close, at most 5m.

terminate.description: End the processes that are still running after the timeout.

include.description: Folder sources only: doublestar glob patterns of the files to add, default all. A pattern without / matches a name in any folder; ** matches any number of folders; a trailing / matches folders only. Case is ignored.

exclude.description: Folder sources only: glob patterns of files and folders to leave out, like include; exclude wins.

guids.description: Folder sources only: the component GUID of a file, by its slash path below the folder (case is ignored). Keeps the codes another tool gave each file; the other files get generated ones.

removeRegistry.description: Registry keys or values deleted when the component is installed, before its own values are written, or keys deleted when it is removed.

name.description: The value to delete. Leave it out to delete the key with all its values and subkeys.

on.description: When to delete: install (also on a repair), uninstall (whole keys only; the install does not create the key) or both.

removeFiles.description: Files or empty folders deleted when the component is installed or removed (RemoveFile rows). A pattern matches the files of one folder only; uninstall rows also run on the uninstall half of a major upgrade.

name.description: A filename that may hold * and ?. Leave it out to remove the folder itself when it is empty.

directory.description: A directory ID, default the component's directory.

removeFolders.description: Folders removed with every file and subfolder in them when the component is installed or removed, but not on the uninstall half of a major upgrade. The folder comes from a property or directory at install time and is moved aside, then deleted at the end without following junctions; drive roots, standard folders, folders that hold one, other users' profiles, folders in the Windows folder and junctions are refused.

property.description: The directory ID or property that holds the folder's full path, for example one a registry search fills.

condition.description: A condition ANDed with the one that decides whether the folder is listed, for example DELETE_DATA="1"; the component's install or remove state still applies.

password.description: Should name a property, such as [SERVICE_PASSWORD].

arguments.description: The service command line: one string, or a list of pieces. A piece with a condition is only added when the condition is true.

deleteOnInstall.description: Delete a service of the same name that is already registered before this one is installed (ServiceControl event 8).

startCondition.description: Start the service at install only when this condition is true. The start moves to a generated component with the condition.

resetAfter.description: A Go duration in whole seconds, such as 24h; replaces resetAfterDays.

restart.description: A Go duration such as 5m; the delay of this restart.

restartDelay.description: A Go duration such as 60s or 1m; 0s restarts at once.

serviceControl.description: Services the package does not install, stopped, started or deleted when the component is installed or removed (ServiceControl rows). Every event is off unless set.

name.description: The service name; may hold [PROPERTY] references.

scope.description: Default: user in a per-user package or component, auto (per machine or per user as installed) in a dual package, machine otherwise.

removeOnUninstall.description: Defaults to true, false for remove.

scope.description: In a perUserOrMachine or perMachineOrUser package only: install the component only in this context. A perMachine component may write HKLM values and machine variables.

purge.description: Delete the component's directory with everything in it on uninstall, not on a major upgrade (FILE-03). The directory and the folders above it must not be configurable.

condition.description: ANDed with the uninstall condition, e.g. DELETE_DATA="1".

preserve.description: Keep the key file or registry value as the user left it across major upgrades: sets neverOverwrite; removeOld defaults to afterInstallExecute.

keyPath.description: A file name, a registry id or "directory".

folderPermissions.description: Secures the component's directory; needs a CreateFolder row (createFolder: true or a directory key path).

shortcuts.description: Shortcuts that point at a file of any component, a folder, a program outside the package or a URL; each names exactly one of file, folder, program or url. They install with this component's features.

name.description: Literal text: no double quote, no [ or ], and not all, which netsh reserves.

description.description: Must not contain a double quote.

component.description: The rule follows this component's state. Required at the top level; a rule under a feature follows the feature.

remoteAddresses.description: netsh remoteip list, comma-separated without spaces or double quotes. Empty (or any, or *) means any; any and * cannot be combined with other entries.

uiStrings.description: Replaces built-in wizard texts by key, for example to build the wizard in another language. Values other than the UIText rows are formatted text; & marks the access key on buttons, check boxes, radio buttons and the browse labels.

search.description: One search: exactly one of registry, directory, file or component.

name.description: Empty reads the key's default value.

type.description: value: the data with the engine's type prefix (#n for a DWORD); directory: the folder the data names, if it exists. Under another search: directory (the default there).

directory.description: Finds a folder; the result ends with a backslash.

path.description: A full path (drive, share or [PROPERTY]), or with under a path relative to that folder.

under.description: The search that finds the folder path is relative to: a registry search, a directory or a component search.

depth.description: How many levels of subfolders may lie between the path's parent and its last folder.

file.description: Finds a file; the result is its full path.

path.description: The folder: a full path, or with under a path relative to that folder.

under.description: The search that finds the folder path is relative to.

depth.description: How many levels of subfolders below the folder are searched too.

minVersion.description: Lowest version, inclusive, in any language unless languages is set.

languages.description: Language IDs the file must have; compared only when its version equals minVersion.

component.description: Finds the folder of an installed component's key path.

keyPath.description: What the component's key path is. file (default): the result is the folder of the key file; directory: the result is the key path folder itself. For a component of this package the builder knows it.

name.description: Shortcut name without .lnk or .url; the 8.3 short name is generated. Defaults to product.name.

file.description: Component shortcuts only: the id or name of a packaged file in any component.

folder.description: Component shortcuts only: a directory id, standard folder or folder path the shortcut opens. A folder that is not a standard folder gets a CreateFolder row.

program.description: Component shortcuts only: the formatted path of a program outside the package, starting with a folder property, such as [SystemFolder]msiexec.exe.

url.description: Component shortcuts only: the address of an Internet shortcut, written as a .url file; formatted text, printable ASCII.

directory.description: A directory id, a standard folder such as DesktopFolder, or a folder path such as ProgramMenuFolder/Example.

workingDirectory.description: Defaults to the file's directory; a component's folder, program and url shortcuts have none.

icon.description: A key of icons; empty shows the target's own icon. Not on url shortcuts, which take iconFile.

iconFile.description: Url shortcuts only: the id or name of a packaged file (.ico, .exe or .dll) whose icon the .url shows.

iconIndex.description: Index of the icon in icon or iconFile; needs one of them.

properties.description: Shell properties of the .lnk by canonical name, such as System.AppUserModel.ID; the values are formatted text. Not on url shortcuts.
